Onimusha: Way of the Sword Hidden Treasures Guide

Hidden Treasures are numbered optional chests found across Eastern Kyoto. This guide covers the five documented Hidden Treasure locations, with extra notes for No. 1 and No. 3 because those are easy to search for and miss.

Hidden Treasure Locations

  • Hidden Treasure No. 1 - Kiyomizu-dera. After the Swaying Bridge section, go through the red metal door near the save statue and check behind the crates.
  • Hidden Treasure No. 2 - Gojo Bridge. After crossing the bridge, take the first lane on the right, use the grapple point, then look past the hole in the wall.
  • Hidden Treasure No. 3 - Nijo Castle. After defeating the strong Genma and opening the metal door, check under the stairs in the southwest corner.
  • Hidden Treasure No. 4 - Kuramadera. After solving the karakuri box and getting the Rusty Key, unlock the door to the north and follow the path to the chest.
  • Hidden Treasure No. 5 - Kitano Tenmangu. Search the west-most lane near the chicken cages. If you lose the route, use Tenkai's guidance to narrow the direction.

Hidden Treasure No. 1

For Hidden Treasure No. 1, the key landmark is the save statue after the Swaying Bridge route in Kiyomizu-dera. Go through the nearby red metal door and inspect the crates instead of staying on the main path.

If you are already past this section, treat the red door and crate pile as your anchor points when backtracking.

Hidden Treasure No. 3

For Hidden Treasure No. 3, progress through Nijo Castle until the strong Genma encounter is cleared and the metal door opens. Once inside, do not rush forward; the chest is under the stairs in the southwest corner.

This is the one players often search as "hidden treasure 3" because the route can look like normal progression after the fight.

Exploration Tips

  • Check side routes after major fights. Several treasure routes open or become easier to reach after combat encounters or gated paths.
  • Look behind stairs, crates, and narrow lanes. Hidden Treasure chests are easy to miss when the main route points forward.
  • Finish nearby locks and mechanisms. No. 4 depends on the Rusty Key route after the karakuri box, so puzzle progress can matter for collectibles.
  • Keep puzzle notes nearby. If you are clearing optional rooms too, the Mask Puzzle Guide covers the mask-order solution.

What This Guide Does Not Guess

This page does not invent extra Hidden Treasure numbers, chest rewards, or unrelated old-game collectible routes. It covers the five documented numbered chests for Onimusha: Way of the Sword only.

FAQ

  • How many Hidden Treasures are in Onimusha: Way of the Sword? Current documented guides list five numbered Hidden Treasure chests.
  • Where is Hidden Treasure No. 1? It is in Kiyomizu-dera, behind crates past the red metal door near the save statue after Swaying Bridge.
  • Where is Hidden Treasure No. 3? It is in Nijo Castle, under the stairs in the southwest corner after the strong Genma encounter and metal door.
  • Is this only a Hidden Treasure 3 guide? No. This is the main Hidden Treasures guide, with No. 3 highlighted because players commonly search for it by number.
